name: Task-pmo_deadline
label: PMO — Committed date (deadline)
description: Committed/deadline date of the task (business or agreed commitment). Different from the Expected End Date, which is the calculated date. It does not shift automatically with rescheduling (can be changed manually). It does not move the task, block saving, or the actual log; if the planned end exceeds it, only a warning is shown. Empty = no commitment.

name: Project-pmo_committed_end_date
label: PMO — Committed end
description: Committed completion date of the project (business or agreed commitment). Different from the Expected End Date, which is the calculated date. It does not shift automatically with the schedule (can be changed manually). It does not block saving; if the calculated end exceeds it, only a warning is shown. Empty = no commitment.

name: Project-pmo_status_date
label: PMO Status Date
description: Cutoff date (Data Date) of the Project's as-of control (ADR-0006). Only today or past; no future date allowed. It is the default value of the cutoff-date status report.

name: ToDo-pmo_planned_hours
label: PMO Planned Hours
description: Planned hours of this assignee for the Task (Capacity Planning). Empty = uniform split of Task.expected_time among assignees.
